core_memory.user_health_history: user has had surgeries, medications, chronic conditions, and seasonal illnesses over the years; has to be careful with joint pain and seasonal illnesses due to living in Kansas; feels like managing health is a part-time job now.
core_memory.user_exercise_preferences: user focuses on consistent, low-impact exercises like walking, which helps with osteoarthritis and blood sugar levels, also practices light yoga a few times a week to alleviate joint pain and improve flexibility, and uses a stationary bike or does at-home workouts on bad weather days.
core_memory.user_sleep_habits: user has developed a bedtime routine to wind down, avoids caffeine after 3 PM, keeps bedroom cool and dark, and reads a book before bed instead of looking at phone, which has made a huge difference in sleep quality and overall health.
core_memory.user_stress_management: user practices mindfulness through deep breathing or meditation for five minutes in the morning, which helps with hypertension, and keeps a gratitude journal to stay positive even on tough days.
core_memory.user_hydration_habits: user makes a conscious effort to stay hydrated by keeping a big water bottle with her all day, drinking herbal teas in the evening instead of coffee, and increasing water intake during hot Kansas summers.
core_memory.user_preventative_care: user prioritizes preventative care by getting regular check-ups, taking medications on time, getting annual vaccines, including flu shot, pneumonia shot, and RSV vaccine, getting annual mammogram, and monitoring bone density due to family history of osteoporosis.
core_memory.user_motivation: user struggles with motivation, especially on days when she doesn't feel like working out or cooking a healthy meal, but has learned to be kind to herself and make better choices the next day, focusing on consistency rather than perfection.
